note: Every skipped or xfailed test in the release run must match one entry whose kind matches and whose profiles include the active profile (L9_SUITE_PROFILE, default ci). pattern is a Python regular expression matched against the whole skip reason. ci entries are the skips CI's service-backed validate job is expected to produce; local entries are the additional skips of a machine without those services or extras. The entries were taken from the skip reasons of a CI-shaped run (PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, the bound semantic authority, the validate job's extras) and, for local, of runs without those services.

entries.pattern: could not import 'constellation_node_sdk': No module named 'constellation_node_sdk'
entries.justification: The constellation SDK is not a locked extra of the validate job; the canonical TransportPacket path is external blocker B-001.
CI checks out only this repository; the cross-repo producer contract runs where a Cursor-Governance checkout is present.
The runtime-status protocol check runs only against an explicitly named Cursor-Governance checkout, which CI does not provide.

entries.pattern: [a-z_]+ is not writable on the agent lane
entries.justification: Structural: the class-vocabulary matrix includes classes the agent lane must refuse; those parameters have no agent-lane round trip to assert.

entries.pattern: L9_MEMORY_TEST_NEO4J_URI is not set; live graph-intelligence (tests|checks) need Neo4j
entries.justification: Live Neo4j suites run in the graph-live and full-capability-live jobs, not in the validate job, which has no Neo4j service.

entries.pattern: L9_MEMORY_TEST_REDIS_STOP_CMD is not set; the Redis outage case needs server control
entries.justification: The Redis stop/start outage case needs server control; it runs in full-capability-live.

entries.pattern: L9_MEMORY_TEST_GRAPHITI_MCP_URL is not set; seam 2 needs a live Graphiti endpoint
entries.justification: Projection seam 2 needs a live Graphiti endpoint and Neo4j, which the validate job does not run.
Live Graphiti qualification needs graphiti-core, which is not a locked extra of the validate job.
Local only: CI provides PostgreSQL, so a PostgreSQL skip in CI is a lost backend leg and must fail.
Local only: CI provides Redis, so a Redis skip in CI is a lost backend leg and must fail.

entries.pattern: L9_SEMANTIC_AUTHORITY_ROOT (is not set; kind-exception law cannot be read|has no semantics/: .*)
entries.justification: Local only: CI checks out the bound Quantum-L9/.github semantic authority, so the kind-exception law must run there.

entries.pattern: the manifest's Zep shadow target needs the zep extra
entries.justification: Local only: CI installs the zep extra.
